verdict.rationale: The Search API lets an agent search and manage indices and records using header-based API-key auth, and official clients exist in many languages. The CLI is positioned for scripts and CI, an `algolia-cli` agent skill manages indices and settings, and an official MCP server is documented; a hands-on user also imported data with a simple node script. Missing for 10: an explicit documented create-index → add-records → query walkthrough for agents, evidence that the MCP server can write or index (it is described only for search, analytics, and recommendations), headless CLI auth (sign-in opens a browser), and a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404).
